paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The difference between probing a single layer and probing the weighted sum of layers. concat is the concatenation of all layers. 0 is the embedding layer. Large negative values on the y-axis mean that probing the particular layer on the x-axis is much worse than probing the weighted sum of all layers.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the difference in percentage point values between probing a single layer and probing the weighted sum of layers in two multilingual BERT models: mBERT and XLM-R. The horizontal axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 12, with 'concat' representing the concatenation of all layers. The vertical axis is labeled '% point difference', with a linear scale from -10 to 0, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The mBERT bars are displayed above the XLM-R bars, both in the same shade of blue. The mBERT bars are arranged in order of layer number and have approximate values ranging from -7.2 at layer 0 to -2.2 at layer 12, with a minimum value of -8.4 at layer 3. The XLM-R bars are also arranged in order of layer number, with approximate values ranging from -9.5 at layer 0 to -1.8 at layer 12. No bars are visually emphasized.
